featured_reviews.name: Freny Karjodkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Heartfelt Appreciation for the Team at Aaji Ghar

We would like to express our deepest gratitude to the entire team at Aaji Ghar for the exceptional care, compassion, and dignity with which our beloved aunt, Moti, was looked after during her most vulnerable days.

From the very beginning, the home felt warm, welcoming, and deeply compassionate—a place where elders are not just treated as patients, but as family. The dedication of the entire 35-member team is truly remarkable. The doctor, Dr. Ruchi, the nurses Aradhana and Rekha, the admin staff Pooja and Nagma, and the counselor Purva—each one of them displayed outstanding professionalism, patience, and empathy. Their affectionate care often exceeded what many elders sadly experience even within their own families.

The 24/7 round-the-clock care, personalized attention, physiotherapy sessions, prayer meets, and meaningful one-on-one interactions brought immense comfort to our aunt. We always felt reassured knowing that emergency medical services were immediately available through their tie-up with Bell Vue Hospital.

Our aunt Moti was a dementia patient, suffering from severe insomnia and episodes of aggression. Despite the many challenges, the staff cared for her with extraordinary patience and kindness—never once complaining, even when she occasionally became violent. Their calm handling, emotional strength, and unwavering commitment will forever stay in our hearts.

We would especially like to thank Aradhana and the other nurse who accompanied Moti Aunty in the ambulance—their support during that critical moment was beyond valuable. After she was shifted back to Aaji Ghar, the round-the-clock palliative care ensured that our Masi’s final hours were peaceful, comfortable, and free from pain. For that, we will always be grateful.

Your team’s dedication truly made a profound difference in our lives during an incredibly difficult time. We cannot thank you enough for your compassion, service, and humanity.

With sincere gratitude,
From Moti Aunty’s family

featured_reviews.name: Gurudas Aras
featured_reviews.review_text: My mother was in Aaji care facility at D N Nagar, Andheri West for nearly 1.5 years. With my personal experience I can say that it is one of the best facilities for elderly people. Even at very old age of my mother she received utmost love and care from the staff. The staff is truly professional in behaviour and is very well trained for any kind of emergencies as well. Right from Dr Rucha, Ms Aradhana , Ms Rekha and all the staff members gave utmost help and support to my mother. The daily routine which includes exercises, activities, entertainment etc kept my mother in good condition. Timely medical checks and reporting kept us update on her health. Unfortunately my mother passed away peacefully last week at the centre but till her last she received full empathy and support from team Aaji care for which I shall always remain grateful. featured_reviews.name: Bina Raj
featured_reviews.review_text:
From Bina Rajagopalan,

We are deeply grateful to Aajicare D N  Nagar Andheri, for the outstanding care they provided to my father, Mr. Dayanand (HD), during his 2 years and 3 months at the center.
Despite his advanced age of 92 and mild dementia, along with challenges like a hip replacement, he received exceptional support in every aspect—nutrition, exercise, medication, and cognitive stimulation.

When my father suffered a fall and fractured his thigh bone, Dr. Ruchi immediately collaborated with Dr. Parth Mehta (MD Orthopedic) to manage his treatment seamlessly.
From transportation to the hospital to surgery and post-operative care, their comprehensive approach ensured the best outcomes and a smooth recovery.

Throughout his stay, the team at Aajicare kept us well-informed about his condition, providing regular updates despite us being in another country.
The video calls every day allowed us to stay connected with him, which meant a lot to our family.
The nurses—Rekha, Aradhana, Varsha, and Sadhana—were incredibly compassionate, caring for my father as though he were their own. Their dedication and warmth were evident in every interaction.

When my father’s condition began to decline, Nurse Aradhana proactively advised me to fly to Mumbai. Thanks to her foresight, I was able to spend precious final days with my father and be by his side when he passed.
Nurse Rekha deserves special recognition for her attentiveness and ability to communicate every detail about my father’s condition—her care was truly exemplary.

The Trimurti of attendants, Avinash, Ajay, and Manish, was always kind, cheerful, and attentive, ensuring my father felt comfortable and cared for at all times.

Dr. Ruchi, from the very beginning, provided unwavering support, combining professionalism with genuine compassion. Her knowledge, efficiency, and attentiveness made all the difference.

We extend our heartfelt thanks to the entire Aajicare team for their extraordinary care, dedication, and support. They gave my father a life of dignity and comfort in his final years, and for that, we will always be grateful.

featured_reviews.name: Sameer Dalvi
featured_reviews.review_text: We would like to thank Aaji Care Centre DN Nagar, for organising and inviting us for a parents day event at Tamarind Tiffin on June 1, 2025. featured_reviews.name: Jocelyn Gopal Pacheco
featured_reviews.review_text:
Choosing a place for my parent was one of the hardest decisions I've had to make, but The Wisdom Club has been a total blessing.

The central location is also a huge plus, making it so easy for me to drop by and visit regularly.

The first thing you notice is how clean and peaceful it feels and it’s got a genuine warmth.

What first gave us peace of mind were the pre-joining meetings with Dr. Prem n Dr Manasa who were so sincere and they wanted to learn about my parent’s personal life story and our specific situation, not just the medical numbers. That level of care is rare.

The daily curated activities keep the atmosphere lively, and the food is a real standout with the Maharaj who prepares simple, tasty, home-cooked meals making it feel so much more personal.

The staff are also incredible, so patient and always smiling even at busy times but a special shout-out to Seema! Her bubbly nature adds so much life and joy to the place.

It is such a relief to see my parent treated with this much love and dignity & just so grateful to have found this place and highly recommend  The Wisdom club to anyone looking for elder care in Mumbai.

featured_reviews.name: Priyanka Chavan

The atmosphere there truly sped up his recovery. It was calm, positive and reassuring in every way. A big thank you to Dr. Prem and Dr. Manasa, along with the wonderful caregiving and nursing staff, for their constant care and support. The Wisdom Club truly stands apart and, in my experience, beats any nursing home facility or setup. Deeply grateful for the care my father received here!

featured_reviews.name: PRATIKSHA BANE
featured_reviews.review_text:
I took my mother to The Wisdom Club for physiotherapy sessions, and the experience has been wonderful. The sessions never felt like a “task”. They were engaging and even fun. Dr. Manasa has a rare ability to keep patients motivated while seamlessly ensuring that all the required exercises are covered.

My mother earlier struggled to stay consistent with physiotherapy, but here she continued her sessions regularly and showed rapid improvement in her mobility. She is now able to walk better and feels much more confident in her movement.

Kudos to the entire team at The Wisdom Club for the care, encouragement and for keeping such a positive environment. Highly recommended for physiotherapy and elder care.

featured_reviews.name: Steffi Evelikar
featured_reviews.review_text: I have been regularly visiting The Wisdom Club with my father for his physiotherapy sessions with Dr.Manasa. And I couldn’t be more happier. I can see great improvement in his mobility and his mood as well. He looks forward to his visits and meeting with all the staff and doctors. It’s a superb initiative and I’ve found it to be one of the best eldercare services in Mumbai!

featured_reviews.name: PinnedCloud
featured_reviews.review_text:
My mother stayed at The Wisdom Club for 21 days while I was travelling and she had a truly positive experience. She often spoke about the warmth of the staff, the comfort of the facility and how well she was cared for throughout her stay.

Though she’s quite independent, the team ensured someone was always present to accompany her from her bed to the bathroom or for her daily walks. She had no complaints about the fresh, home-style meals prepared by their in-house Maharaj (her only complaint was that she ate more than she usually does at home!).

Before her stay, both of us met Dr.Prem and the staff, who took the time to understand her medical history, daily routine and medications, ensuring a seamless transition.

She enjoyed the guided yoga sessions, escorted walks and creative daily activities like diya painting that made each day engaging and joyful.

If there’s one area they could strengthen, it’s setting up smoother communication systems, well-defined processes for different situations in the exploration phase and learning to say “no” when needed. They’re a young, growing organisation and I’m confident they’ll get there.

I had checked several respite and assisted-care centres for seniors in Mumbai before choosing The Wisdom Club. Like many elderly Indians, my mother wasn’t keen on staying in one, but by the end, she told them, “I’ll be back when my daughter travels again.” That says it all.

My experience with The Wisdom Club has been extremely positive and reassuring. My mother suffers from both Dementia (Alzheimers) and PD and while I was extremely apprehensive in enrolling her as a resident at a care facility, the whole team made this transition possible. They have a great founding team and this made all the difference. Head nursing staff is very caring and they lead the associates well. Overall they seem to function operationally as one big happy family and have been very approachable. My special thanks to Dr Prem, Dr Manasa and Mr. George and Ms Seema.

Keep up the great work! Its something the community needs in this day and age.

featured_reviews.name: Tina Gandhi
featured_reviews.review_text:
I visited Sahabhaav, a remarkable facility dedicated to our aging loved ones, and I can’t speak highly enough of the experience. From the moment I stepped in, the warmth and care radiating from the staff were truly heartwarming. The environment is thoughtfully designed—spacious, serene, and filled with little touches that make it feel like home, for the residents to relax or socialize.

What sets Sahabhaav apart is its holistic approach. The team doesn’t just focus on physical well-being but nurtures emotional and mental health with engaging activities like art classes, music sessions, and group yoga and monthly picnics that spark joy and connection. The caregivers are compassionate professionals who treat residents like family, always attentive to their needs while respecting their dignity and independence.

The facility is spotless, with modern amenities that prioritize safety and comfort, like accessible rooms and round-the-clock medical support. Meals are nutritious and tailored, with menus that cater to both health needs and personal tastes, which my loved one absolutely raved about! My mother is now a part of this wonderful place.

Sahabhaav isn’t just a care facility—it’s a community where seniors thrive, surrounded by love and respect. I am feel confident that this is a place where aging is celebrated with grace and joy. Highly recommend it to anyone seeking a nurturing home for their dear ones!

My gratitude to Dr. Mini and her capable and empathetic staff.

featured_reviews.name: Steven DSouza
featured_reviews.review_text:
We needed to find a 24/7 care facility for my dad after his life changed dramatically with a stroke and other complications that followed. I'm so glad we discovered Sahabhaav. Looking back at the last few months of my dad's life, we're glad that we put our trust in Sahabhaav because the team took care of him like family. We received daily WhatsApp updates and they brought in the right doctors to help with medical care over the next few months. They also made it easier for us to make the really difficult decisions, and I will always be grateful for that. I wish my dad recovered enough to be able to enjoy living at Sahabhaav, but at least we know they did everything to manage his pain as best as they could. It's comforting to know (for other members of our family) that the team at Sahabhaav are capable of running a facility that is a home for the elderly, but also they're very capable at managing more serious medical emergencies.

A big thank you to Jasleen and Dr. Mini for being really good humans that have made a very difficult year for our family easier to cope with.

featured_reviews.name: Jardin Lobo
featured_reviews.review_text:
After our mum suffered a series of haemorrhagic strokes alongside a fronto-temporal dementia diagnosis, she has required 24x7 dedicated care and medical attention. Dr. Mini and her brilliant team at Sahabhaav relentlessly catered to our mum's needs with patience, grace and kindness. The level of care and comfort provided by the doctors, nurses and staff at Sahabhaav, including Jasleen, Rumeet, Alka and the team, is of a very high and unwavering standard. They make the residents at Sahabhaav feel at home and treat them like their very own, and leave the families with a sense of peace and calm, knowing that our loved ones are well cared for.
Sometimes, the best thing we can do for our loved ones is to recognise and provide them with the special attention and care they require, in an environment built primarily for this purpose. Sahabhaav is this specialised environment, and it's the staff at Sahabhaav who make it special.
A massive thanks to you and your team, Dr. Mini, for taking care of our mum with  love and warmth.

featured_reviews.name: Neha Goel
featured_reviews.review_text:
My mother has truly found a new life here. Before coming to Sahabhav, she often said she didn’t even wish to live anymore due to her medical struggles. But now, after 1.5 years, she’s smiling, laughing, and cherishing each day. She’s become bubbly and chirpy, just like in her younger days, and nothing brings us more joy than seeing her happy again.

Dr. Mini, you are no less than an angel—a modern-day Mother Teresa and Florence Nightingale for the Sahabhav family. Your dedication and love for every resident are beyond words.

Sahabhav is not just a care center—it is a scientifically designed haven for the elderly. Every activity, from hand-eye coordination exercises, physiotherapy, and chair yoga is thoughtfully planned to enhance motor skills.

Festivals are celebrated with creative craft activities, making every occasion extra special—more than we could ever plan at home. Every resident is encouraged to participate, creating a true sense of togetherness.

Sahabhav truly lives up to their vision: "Age is just a number; we make every day count." Well-planned outings to places like Juhu ISKCON Temple, the Dhirubhai Ambani fountain show, Christmas at the Taj, and relaxing beach and garden picnics prove that life doesn’t slow down with age. Dance classes, singing sessions, bhajan sandhyas, and inspiring interactions with personalities like Miss India Diva Sonal Kukreja bring so much joy.

Like any home, Sahabhav has its challenges. But what truly stands out is how Dr. Mini and Amee handle everything—with positivity, patience, and unwavering support.

Dr. Mini, thank you from the bottom of our hearts for giving my mother and so many others a reason to smile every day.
Amee, your understanding and constant support mean the world.

Rumeet, your kindness never goes unnoticed—bringing your homemade sooji halwa for the residents’ puja rituals is truly heartwarming.

Sahabhav proves that life doesn’t slow down with age—it only gets more colorful. Thank you for making every day count!

A Haven of Care and Compassion

There are moments in life when we come face-to-face with the extraordinary commitment of others, and my family's experience with Aaji Care's Aarambh Versova is a shining example.  When dementia's shadow fell upon my father, we felt overwhelmed. Yet, this exceptional care center stepped forward as a beacon of hope.

From the first moment we entered, we were enveloped in warmth and understanding. The facility is thoughtfully designed, fostering a serene and secure environment so essential for those living with dementia. The staff, without exception, possess a unique blend of professionalism and heart. They understand that dementia care isn't simply medical, but deeply rooted in respect and personal connection. Their patience knows no bounds, and they find creative ways to engage with each resident, fostering moments of joy.

The activities and programs go beyond mere entertainment, providing both mental stimulation and a sense of purpose.  We've seen how music, gentle exercise, and reminiscence therapy can bring a spark back into my father's eyes, and for that, we are eternally grateful.

We would be remiss if we didn't extend special acknowledgment to Dr. Ruchi and her team of doctors and nursing staff. Their expertise in dementia care is matched only by their compassion. They've guided us through challenging moments, always taking the time to explain and reassure. Their dedication extends far beyond medical management, ensuring my father is treated with the dignity and respect he so richly deserves.

It's rare to find an institution that goes above and beyond what is expected. Aaji Care Aarambh exemplifies this. They are not simply providing care,  they are providing a lifeline for families like ours. The service they offer is an act of profound kindness and deserves our deepest appreciation.

featured_reviews.name: Sujata Shirsekar _ Staff - WhiteOakES
featured_reviews.review_text: Aarambh Aaji care has been a lifesaver for my family in helping me care for my mother. The caregivers have been wonderful with her. They are so caring and compassionate. Everyone in the office as well as all the administrative staff , especially Ajay Pillai, have been top notch and great in communicating with me whenever I  have had needs or concerns regarding her care. featured_reviews.name: Meena Joglekar
featured_reviews.review_text:
We brought our parents to Aarambh
about a year and half ago. Both my brother and I are based in the US with family obligations there as well. Although our father’s health is good, due to age (95 years) we felt he would not be able to cope with household duties as well as assisting our mother, who began to need help due to mobility issues (and recently passed away).
We give Aarambh high marks on all the factors that were important to us.

The second is the excellent yoga instructor who comes in 3 times a week, and also a regular physical therapist. Aarambh also has well-planned outings to nearby parks, the beach and temples periodically.
Asma and Milan manage a clean, efficiently run facility, which for our parents included A/C, TV, daily cleaning and chair-lift to the upper level. Finally, it was very important to have a good communication system in place in order to stay in touch via video on a daily basis. Aarambh provides good wifi and phone access.
We are very happy to have found Aarambh, and highly recommend it.
Meena Joglekar & Uday Watwe

Dear Team Sahabhaav
My heartfelt thanks to each one of you for giving a beautiful home to my father for the last 2 years of his life.Selfless service and caring nature by each one of you filled his days with joy.

featured_reviews.name: Hemant
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am very grateful to Sahabhaav for the love and care they provided to my father for the last 2+ years; esp. to the management team (Dr. Mini, Amee) and all the care takers. There are not enough words to describe the quality and the level of support they provided.

Everyone at Sahabhaav became like an extended family for my father and he felt at home over there. He enjoyed the quality and variety of the tasty food provided and always praised it. Even his lifestyle improved with all the activities, outings, and celebrations. They encouraged everyone to participate and be active. The staff kept us informed by sharing photos and videos of various activities and events and made us feel part of the celebrations. At times, when my dad felt a little sad, the staff took special efforts to make him feel better.

Sahabhaav is very well-equipped to provide immediate medical assistance like pathology tests, IV and other nursing needs. They even arranged for specialty doctors to visit on-site for consultation and treatment, including a dentist and that reduced visits to outside clinics. The in-house doctors, nurses and caretakers were always there to support him and make him feel comfortable throughout his stay.

I would like to specially mention that whenever he needed to be hospitalized, Sahabhaav took care of everything from calling the ambulance, monitoring his progress, and coordinating all aspects of his care and treatment needed with the hospital staff. When he was in ICU, they provided a 24-hour caretaker and kept us informed.

I would highly recommend Sahabhaav to anyone who is looking for round the clock support and care for their elderly loved ones at a home away from home.

featured_reviews.review_text: Dear Dr Mini, Amee and team sahabhaav - My mother spent 2yr+ at S1 as a patient with dementia. I personally spent visits over 100days at the centre and have observed first hand the quality of the place and care. Also, love the food. Thanks for making my mothers last times as good as they could have been.  I will be happy to share more details and Dr Mini can connect you with me.

featured_reviews.review_text:

Dr. Mini who owns the place takes personal interest in all those in the Home. She respects individual differences and meets many needs whether big or small when possible.

Residents are given freedom and do not have restrictions imposed on them ... Relatives and friends can visit at any time which makes it easy for caregivers to visit frequently..

Money cannot buy love!  This is a place where you feel loved... It is run in such a way that I felt I was in a home away from home... It was like being part of a nice big family..

I strongly recommend this place for seniors.

featured_reviews.name: Naveen Keswani
featured_reviews.review_text:
Our father was diagnosed with Parkinson's and Dementia around the age of 85. With advanced age & a rapid deterioration, it was a massive challenge to find a suitable assisted living caregiving environment (Vs the routine senior citizen homes) for our father who needed round-the-clock care as well as interaction with the seniors’ community. In Sahabhaav, we found a place that met both these requirements excellently.

Sahabhaav has a warm, homely environment with neat upkeep and provides homecooked food with an emphasis on simple daily activities that keep the elderly engaged. There is excellent communication with the family at all times and updates of the loved ones are shared on a daily basis, through videos and text messages.

Dr Panicker, Ms Amee and Ms Neelam with their dedicated team of nurses and caregivers see to the overall well- being of the residents. They even took the residents (mostly wheelchair bound) to monthly outings -  to parks and malls! Festivals & even simple events like Women's day or Ram Mandir ceremony were celebrated by all with a lot of fun.

Though we had a relatively brief association with Sahabhaav of around 6 months (as our father sadly passed away), they took good care of him especially during the challenging last couple of months when he was bedridden and needed oxygen and feeding tube.In this context, it’s important to note that Sahabhaav is well equipped to handle basic nursing needs without hospitalization.

We would highly recommend Sahabhaav to anyone looking for a kind, loving, caring and at the same time well-equipped place run by an extremely competent and dedicated team.

Wishing Sahabhaav all the very best. You have raised the benchmark in caregiving.

Naveen and Shalini

featured_reviews.name: Ranjit Paliath
featured_reviews.review_text:
I evaluated Sahabhaav, as my one of my friends abroad was looking  for an old age home for his parents.
The place is well located and is a great set up overall.  It is very different from the old age homes that I have seen.  The place is clean,  well lit up and richly furnished like an upscale resort.
The facilities are great and what makes the place special is the people that take care of the inmates like Dr.Mini Panickar,  Ami Shah and their team.
They do activities during festivals and Ganapati Bapa was set up when i went there.  The delicacies made for the occasion were mouth watering while keeping in mind the clientele they cater too.
I am really impressed by the concept and the work that is being done by the team.
Keep up the great work.

featured_reviews.name: jnerikaat
featured_reviews.review_text:
Dear Mini, Neelam, Jasleen, Amee, and ALL the other staff at Sahabhaav,

Our deepest gratitude and heartfelt thanks to you and all at Sahabhaav for taking such great care of our Mom during her last years.

She had lived alone in her apartment in Mumbai with in-home care that she had to manage herself which became difficult for her with age. Moving her to Sahabhaav transformed her life into a full-service, loving, respectful care in all aspects, including interaction and community with the other residents.

When Mom moved to Sahabhaav, she was unable to walk. Within days with the help of physiotherapy, Mom started walking. This was a very happy turn of events for Mom and everyone. Mom received attentive personal care, medical care, great food, festival celebrations - Ganapathi, Gokulashtami, Navratri, Deepavali, Christmas, and New Years. There was play, exercise, outings, fashion shows, make-overs, hair braiding and styling, spa treatments, yoga, singing and much more. These activities gave Mom the gift of touch and hugs that are so important for elders and the opportunity to participate in fun activities, feel special, and show their talents even in old age. When one of us wanted to talk to Mom, we texted Sahabhaav requesting a Whatsapp connection with her. This gave Mom a feeling of being connected to us across national borders. The staff at Sahabhaav always demonstrated genuine, caring service for Mom and the other elder residents.

We thank all at Sahabhaav for doing this great service. May we all be blessed with such great fortune when we reach that stage in life. Please pass on the legacy and training to future generations to keep this noble service going forward. Elder care is challenging work and it is a genuine calling in life. The people who do this work are exceptional souls on earth.

Our Mom lived at Sahabhaav from Aug 2021 to May 2024. We are eternally grateful that she had a great time during these last years.

Most gratefully,

Pradeep, Dilip, Anoop, Jyoti and Ashok.
